keyChanges.en: Price declined 14.79% over 7 days to $7.39, testing market confidence in post-burn valuation floor

fullReasoning.en: UNI faces structural headwinds despite protocol strength. The DEX generates $79.84M annualized revenue, but only 17% ($13.57M) flows to buybacks. At $7.39, this purchases just 1.84M UNI annually against 20M UNI emissions—net inflation of +2.05%. This math explains why bullish narratives failed: the big burn already happened, but ongoing emissions create a persistent ceiling. The 14.79% weekly decline signals repricing of this reality. TVL down 3.55% and $11.11M daily volume (anemic for $4.6B cap) compound pressure—thin liquidity amplifies selloffs. Derivatives show minimal conviction: $40.57M OI is structurally low, +0.01% funding is dead neutral. Governance is quiet on the critical catalyst: no real-yield staking RFC visible. Without that pivot, UNI remains priced on narrative rather than DCF, and the post-burn scarcity narrative is empirically false. The protocol works, revenue flows, but token holders bleed value to net inflation. Until buyback budget exceeds emissions or real-yield passes governance, UNI is structurally capped regardless of protocol success.
fullReasoning.zh: 尽管协议强劲，UNI 面临结构性逆风。DEX 产生年化收入 $7984 万，但仅 17%（$1357 万）用于回购。在 $7.39 价位，年化仅能回购 184 万 UNI，而年排放量为 2000 万——净通胀率 +2.05%。这一数学现实解释了看涨叙事失效的原因：大规模销毁已完成，但持续排放形成了价格天花板。7 日 14.79% 跌幅表明市场正在重新定价这一现实。TVL 下降 3.55% 且日交易量仅 $1111 万（对于 $46 亿市值严重不足）加剧压力——流动性薄弱放大抛售冲击。衍生品显示信心极低：$4057 万未平仓合约结构性偏低，+0.01% 资金费率完全中性。治理层面对关键催化剂保持沉默：未见实际收益质押 RFC 提案。在此转型实现前，UNI 依赖叙事而非现金流定价，而销毁后稀缺性叙事已被实证证伪。协议运转良好、收入稳定，但代币持有者的价值被净通胀侵蚀。除非回购预算超过排放量，或实际收益质押通过治理，否则无论协议多成功，UNI 都面临结构性估值上限。
